name: Micrometeor Shower
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: Pebbles and boulders broken off from Barrow's crust accelerate all around the space between the Fracture and the surface, smashing into anything and everything!
disable: DC 20 Acrobatics to avoid impact, DC 23 Athletics or Strike (AC 20) to break or deflect incoming debris

defensiveAbilities.name: Impact
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature fails its check to disable or avoid the hazard

Effect Micrometeors slam into the target, dealing (2d10+13) Bludgeoning Damage damage and potentially knocking them off course based on a DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and gains the Untethered condition, which persists until the start of the next encounter.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage.
